sources_considered.why: Primary financial filing available before the evaluation cutoff, including retrospective quarterly figures and expense definitions.
Readable Reuters reporting concerns 2025 adjusted margins, not a matching first-quarter 2026 serving-cost series.
read_page returned HTTP 403. Search-result text was not used as evidence.
A secondary compilation was not needed where Anthropic's primary filing was available.

evidence_items.locator: Note 8, Supplemental Operating Expense Information, footnote 1; quarterly comparison on pages 158–159
evidence_items.explanation: The quarterly table reports total compute and infrastructure expense at 144% of revenue in Q4 2025 and 72% in Q1 2026, contrary to proportional growth for that broader expense measure. The filing distinguishes this measure from customer-serving cost of revenue, so the comparison does not settle the industry-wide serving-cost claim.

metric_scope.metric: Total compute and infrastructure expense as a percentage of revenue

unresolved_gaps: No representative, consistently defined first-quarter serving-cost and revenue series was located.
Anthropic's quarterly total-compute figures include workloads beyond customer serving.
The claim supplies no accounting basis; under the stated grading rules it cannot receive a supported or contradicted money verdict.
No objective threshold is supplied for too expensive.
